title: Japanese Crispy Air-Fried Casabe Fritters
description: Crispy, air-fried Japanese fritters made with casabe flour, perfect as a snack or side dish.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine casabe flour and water. Mix until a dough forms.
2. Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth.
3. Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
4. Shape each piece into a ball and then flatten slightly into a disk.
5. Heat 1-2 inches of oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
6. When the oil is hot, add 2-3 fritters to the pan and fry until crispy and golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
7. Remove the fritters from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
8. In a small bowl, mix together stir-fry sauce, soy sauce, and sugar.
9. Brush the sauce mixture onto the fritters while still warm.
10. Serve the fritters hot and enjoy!
